decisions.reason: A hearty bread close to the core range has stayed on offer since 2018 with no sign of a shortfall, so management has no trigger for problemistic search and the product costs little to carry in a growing industry.
This sweet pastry fits established production and was still listed in 2019, which suggests satisfactory results, though bakery assortments rotate pastries more often than breads.
The farmhouse bread is a low-cost extension of the core bread line, and nothing indicates it misses the firm's aspiration level, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen with its own web page clearly exceeds aspirations based on peer comparison, which strongly favours retaining this seasonal specialty.
The gold-awarded premium stollen is above external quality benchmarks and supports the firm's heritage and gift positioning, so there is no reason to drop it.
